## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `priority32` (32-bit registered priority encoder: index of the highest set bit of a, plus a found flag) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module priority32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire hit_0 = |a_i[31:0];
wire [4:0] idx_0 = a_i[31] ? 5'd31 : a_i[30] ? 5'd30 : a_i[29] ? 5'd29 : a_i[28] ? 5'd28 : a_i[27] ? 5'd27 : a_i[26] ? 5'd26 : a_i[25] ? 5'd25 : a_i[24] ? 5'd24 : a_i[23] ? 5'd23 : a_i[22] ? 5'd22 : a_i[21] ? 5'd21 : a_i[20] ? 5'd20 : a_i[19] ? 5'd19 : a_i[18] ? 5'd18 : a_i[17] ? 5'd17 : a_i[16] ? 5'd16 : a_i[15] ? 5'd15 : a_i[14] ? 5'd14 : a_i[13] ? 5'd13 : a_i[12] ? 5'd12 : a_i[11] ? 5'd11 : a_i[10] ? 5'd10 : a_i[9] ? 5'd9 : a_i[8] ? 5'd8 : a_i[7] ? 5'd7 : a_i[6] ? 5'd6 : a_i[5] ? 5'd5 : a_i[4] ? 5'd4 : a_i[3] ? 5'd3 : a_i[2] ? 5'd2 : a_i[1] ? 5'd1 : a_i[0] ? 5'd0 : 5'd0;

wire [5:0] chosen_0 = hit_0 ? {1'b1, idx_0} : 6'd0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= chosen_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 208.81 um^2, WNS 7.64557 ns, score 76.24689.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 138.586 um^2, WNS 7.70216 ns, estimated score 76.883014 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: Good improvement. Let's try a balanced-tree version that folds the "found" flag into the chosen value directly (avoiding a separate large OR-reduction), which might reduce area/depth further.

The pure chain-with-folded-flag version (submission 2, score 76.677648) remains the best verified result, outperforming both the baseline (76.24689) and other variants tried (tree-based: 76.114, hybrid half-chain: 76.440). I'll finalize with that result.

input.summary: Optimized priority32 by eliminating the redundant 32-input OR-reduction (hit_0) that duplicated information already implicit in the priority chain. Instead of separately computing hit_0 = |a_i and idx_0 via a ternary chain then combining as {hit_0, idx_0}, the winning version directly encodes the combined 6-bit result (32+bit_index, or 0 if none) in a single priority ternary chain, so the "found" flag falls out naturally from whether the chain result is nonzero. This was formally proven equivalent (Yosys equiv_induct -seq 4: PROVEN) and passed the full simulation benchmark. Explored alternatives included a full balanced binary tree leading-one-detector (formally proven, but place-and-route score 76.114, worse than baseline), a for-loop-based combinational priority encoder, and a two-level (16+16) hybrid chain (P&R score 76.440). The best verified result was the single folded-flag priority chain: post-route area 205.352 um^2, WNS 7.6883 ns, score 76.677648, versus the reference RTL's 208.81 um^2 / 7.64557 ns / 76.24689 — an improvement of about +0.43 in score with lower area and better timing margin, at zero behavioral difference (cycle-accurate equivalence proven).
